report: Abstract and continuous mathematics through explicit iPRA presentations

global_scope.base_theory: Intuitionistic first-order primitive recursive arithmetic with equality, PR defining equations, successor axioms, and quantifier-free induction.
global_scope.producer_scope: Schemes in fixed specified PR producers, moduli and nets; only their numerical parameters are quantified internally. No universal PR evaluator or numerical universe of all functions.
global_scope.human_complete_meaning: The report gives human arguments at the displayed hypotheses. This status is not a claim that the corresponding new Prf PRAAx proof values have been constructed.
global_scope.semantic_layer: Completions, continuous functions, metric structures, Hilbert solutions and holomorphic functions interpret the finite arithmetic estimates externally.

checked_host_development.boundary: These are host Lean theorems. Rat-library axiom dependencies are disclosed; the new arithmetic object proofs remain planned. Existing ProveIt interfaces are integration targets, not imports of this standalone checked project.

claims.title: Bounded conjunctions require only quantifier-free induction
hypotheses: A fixed decidable PR predicate with a Boolean characteristic and explicit finite scan bounds.
claims.conclusion: Bounded universal/existential assertions have Boolean-fold representations, and bounded loop invariants can use quantifier-free induction.
claims.object_ipra_status: Planned Prf PRAAx derivations; no new literal object proof value for this result is delivered.
key_exclusions: Does not permit induction on an arbitrary unbounded universal formula.

claims.title: Rational separation
hypotheses: Rational r,s,C with C>=0; r<=s+C*2^(-k) for every natural k.
claims.conclusion: r<=s, by an explicit rational precision contradiction.
claims.object_ipra_status: Planned Prf PRAAx derivations; no new literal object proof value for this result is delivered.
key_exclusions: An intuitionistic rational-order argument, not a general real limit or Markov principle.

claims.title: Compilation of the finite parts
hypotheses: Fixed PR symbols.
Input contracts supplied as actual iPRA derivations.
Each loop has a specified quantifier-free or Booleanized bounded invariant with derived base and step inequalities.
claims.conclusion: An effective transformation composes these supplied proof terms into a finite-correctness iPRA derivation.
claims.object_ipra_status: External transformation of supplied derivations; not an internal self-soundness theorem. New application proof terms remain to be implemented.
key_exclusions: Conditional metatheorem; does not assert that every true PR specification is provable or every constructive proof compiles to iPRA.

claims.title: Dense extension with explicit demand
hypotheses: Rational metric presentations and a fixed PR dense evaluator E(a,r).
A fixed monotone PR demand mu with mu(k)>=k.
The supplied joint law dX(a,b)<=2^(-mu(k)), r,s>=k+2 implies dY(E(a,r),E(b,s))<=2^(-k).
claims.conclusion: q maps to the regular name n |-> E(q(mu(n)),n+2); equivalent names have equivalent images. Semantically the extension is continuous and uniquely determined among uniformly continuous extensions by its dense values.
claims.object_ipra_status: Planned Prf PRAAx derivations; no new literal object proof value for this result is delivered.
key_exclusions: No numerical universe of all PR programs or all Cauchy names is formed.

claims.title: Products and change of dense presentation
hypotheses: Products use the maximum metric.
For change of presentation: a fixed PR isometry f and a supplied PR selector s with dY(f(s(b,k)),b)<=2^(-k).
claims.conclusion: Completion preserves finite products; the dense isometry becomes an isomorphism with inverse name n |-> s(y(n+2),n+2).
claims.object_ipra_status: Planned Prf PRAAx derivations; no new literal object proof value for this result is delivered.
key_exclusions: Bare density without a PR approximation selector does not supply the effective inverse.

claims.title: Quantitative back-and-forth for finite restrictions
hypotheses: Fixed finite continuous-formula syntax with min, max, 1-u, inf and sup.
Nonempty finite domain lists in each sort with two-sided delta-covering.
Free environments are delta-close and all atomic occurrences differ by at most eta on delta-close tuples.
claims.conclusion: Finite formula values differ by at most eta, without quantifier-depth loss. Atomic evaluation errors eA,eB add at most eA+eB.
claims.object_ipra_status: Planned Prf PRAAx derivations; no new literal object proof value for this result is delivered.
key_exclusions: The checked positive Boolean transfer lemma is only a logical nucleus of this numerical theorem.
Finite quantifier restrictions need not be finite submodels: ambient dense operations need not close the finite domains.

claims.title: PR values for compactly presented metric formulas
hypotheses: A fixed finite signature/formula with PR dense constants, function/predicate evaluators and proved moduli.
Each sort has a nonempty PR finite-net producer with its covering theorem over the dense presentation.
Free inputs have specified PR regular-name families.
For the extension beyond exact dense atoms: supplied uniform PR atomic approximations with explicit errors; named constants are handled through this approximate variant.
claims.conclusion: The explicit finite-net evaluations form a PR regular Cauchy name of the continuous formula value, independent of valid input names and net choices.
claims.object_ipra_status: Planned Prf PRAAx derivations; no new literal object proof value for this result is delivered.
key_exclusions: No compactness/completeness theorem for arbitrary consistent theories.
No exact truth decision from a value name.
Quantification over non-totally-bounded sorts is not covered.

claims.title: Alternating minimax example and coherent optimizer
hypotheses: c,x range over [0,1]; P(c,x)=abs(x^2-c*x).
claims.conclusion: inf_c sup_x P(c,x)=3-2*sqrt(2), with unique optimizer c*=2*sqrt(2)-2. The gap w(c)-v>=abs(c-c*)/4 implies a dyadic grid minimizer at mesh 2^(-j) is within 32*2^(-j), so j=n+6 yields a PR regular optimizer name.
claims.object_ipra_status: Planned Prf PRAAx derivations; no new literal object proof value for this result is delivered.
key_exclusions: Coherent witness recovery uses the proved quantitative gap, not generic compactness.

claims.title: Quantitative partition of unity
hypotheses: Positive rational r and an inhabited finite r/2-net with n centers.
Tent weights w_i=max(0,r-d(x,c_i)); normalized weights lambda_i=w_i/sum(w).
claims.conclusion: The denominator is at least r/2; the normalized weights sum to one and their l1 variation is at most (4n/r)d(x,y). Reconstruction from coefficients bounded by B has Lipschitz constant 4Bn/r and is nonexpansive in coefficient sup distance.
claims.object_ipra_status: Planned Prf PRAAx derivations; no new literal object proof value for this result is delivered.
key_exclusions: Weights are continuous and Lipschitz; smoothness or holomorphicity is not asserted.

claims.title: Finite continuous approximants with an entropy bound
hypotheses: Rational metric basis with nonempty PR nets and their covering proofs.
A fixed PR real-valued family evaluator, integer range bound B>=0, and common PR spatial modulus mu with the stated rational error contracts.
claims.conclusion: At precision k a PR-selected continuous reconstruction approximates each family member within 2^(-k-1); the explicit exterior cover has H_k=(2B*2^(k+3)+1)^(N(mu(k+2)+2)) entries.
claims.object_ipra_status: Planned Prf PRAAx derivations; no new literal object proof value for this result is delivered.
key_exclusions: Cover centers need not belong to the original family.
No selection of a convergent subsequence.
Bare pointwise equicontinuity is not used as a replacement for the supplied common modulus.

claims.title: Finite-rank approximation of continuous functions
hypotheses: The same metric nets and common function modulus as in the quantitative Ascoli construction.
claims.conclusion: P_k f=sum_i lambda_i f(c_i) is positive, linear, constant-preserving, of norm at most one and finite-dimensional range; its uniform error is at most 2^(-k-2).
claims.object_ipra_status: Planned Prf PRAAx derivations; no new literal object proof value for this result is delivered.
key_exclusions: Continuous-function-space language is semantic; all continuous functions are not made into one numerical sort.

claims.title: Finite approximants recover regularity
hypotheses: At each precision j, a finite nonempty list covers the family to uniform error 2^(-j).
The approximants have supplied PR moduli; the j=0 list has supplied integer range bounds.
claims.conclusion: The family has range bound 1+max_i C_i and common modulus max_{i<L_(k+2)} nu(k+2,i,k+1).
claims.object_ipra_status: Planned Prf PRAAx derivations; no new literal object proof value for this result is delivered.
key_exclusions: A covering-index algorithm is unnecessary for this implication; the finite cover assertion remains a hypothesis.

claims.title: Continuous gluing with a produced modulus
hypotheses: A finite r/2-net with n centers.
Local functions on the 2r-balls with bounds B and Lipschitz constant L; total PR local evaluators are correct inside their guards.
Discrepancy is at most alpha where both center distances are less than r.
claims.conclusion: Guarded tent-weighted gluing is bounded by B, has Lipschitz constant 2nL+4nB/r, and differs from f_j by at most alpha on its r-ball. Exact agreement gives a global gluing of the restrictions to the r-balls.
claims.object_ipra_status: Planned Prf PRAAx derivations; no new literal object proof value for this result is delivered.
key_exclusions: No assertion of agreement on the full 2r-balls.
No finite cover is manufactured from an arbitrary open-cover enumeration.
Approximate holomorphic agreement does not make the weighted output holomorphic.

claims.title: Perturbed contraction
hypotheses: 0<=q<1; delta=1-q; e_(j+1)<=q*e_j+eta and e_0<=R, with nonnegative errors.
claims.conclusion: e_j<=q^j R+eta sum_{i<j}q^i<=q^j R+eta/delta.
claims.object_ipra_status: Planned Prf PRAAx derivations; no new literal object proof value for this result is delivered.

claims.title: A clock without logarithms
hypotheses: 0<delta<=1, q=1-delta, integer h with h*delta>=1; integer R>=1.
claims.object_ipra_status: Planned Prf PRAAx derivations; no new literal object proof value for this result is delivered.

claims.title: Coercivity supplies the contraction gap
hypotheses: A real-linear strong operator with <Av,v>>=m||v||^2 and ||Av||<=M||v||, where 0<m<=M.
claims.conclusion: lambda=m/M^2, delta=m^2/(2M^2), q=1-delta make T(v)=v-lambda Av+lambda b a q-contraction.
claims.object_ipra_status: Planned Prf PRAAx derivations; no new literal object proof value for this result is delivered.
key_exclusions: No spectral theorem or orthonormal basis is used.

claims.title: Quantitative operator Lax-Milgram
hypotheses: A rational pre-Hilbert presentation.
Fixed PR strong evaluators a(v,k),b(k) with errors at most 2^(-k), and their derived finite contracts.
Positive rational coercivity/norm bounds 0<m<=M and a rational data bound B>=0.
claims.conclusion: The finite recurrence with the displayed H7 clock produces a regular name c_n of the unique Au=b solution; ||c_n-u||<=2^(-n-2), ||c_n-c_l||<=2^(-n-1) for l>=n, and ||u||<=B/m.
claims.object_ipra_status: Planned Prf PRAAx derivations; no new literal object proof value for this result is delivered.
key_exclusions: The compiled scalar budget is not a formalization of the Hilbert operator or its finite radius contract.
Weak functional/bilinear values alone do not supply the strong inputs.
No extension to zero coercivity is claimed.

claims.title: Residual certification and stability
hypotheses: The strong operator solver hypotheses and a represented comparison v.
For perturbation: a second operator with the same coercivity lower bound m, data norm bound Btilde, data difference beta and operator-norm difference xi.
claims.conclusion: ||v-u||<=||Av-b||/m and ||u-utilde||<=beta/m+xi*Btilde/m^2.
claims.object_ipra_status: Planned Prf PRAAx derivations; no new literal object proof value for this result is delivered.

claims.title: Polynomial inequalities and Green operator
hypotheses: Rational polynomials; P0 consists of those vanishing at 0 and 1, with energy inner product integral(p prime*q prime).
claims.conclusion: Energy norm dominates uniform and L2 norms on P0. The explicit polynomial G has zero endpoints, -G(p) double-prime=p, <Gp,v>_E=integral(pv), and ||Gp||_E<=||p||_L2.
claims.object_ipra_status: Planned Prf PRAAx derivations; no new literal object proof value for this result is delivered.
key_exclusions: The derivative of a general energy name is an L2 name, not automatically a pointwise derivative.

claims.title: Weak elliptic Dirichlet equation
hypotheses: a has a fixed PR rational-polynomial uniform name and rational bounds 0<m<=a(x)<=M on [0,1].
f has a fixed PR polynomial name in the L2 completion, errors <=2^(-k), and norm bound B.
claims.conclusion: A PR regular sequence of rational zero-boundary polynomials names the unique u with integral(a*u prime*v prime)=integral(fv) for all energy-space v. Energy and uniform errors at index n are <=2^(-n-2). The strong operator and Green data are constructed explicitly.
claims.object_ipra_status: Planned Prf PRAAx derivations; no new literal object proof value for this result is delivered.
key_exclusions: The theorem concerns a weak solution in the stated named completions; classical pointwise second derivatives are not asserted.

claims.title: Exact missing datum for a rational ell2 vector
hypotheses: A fixed PR rational coordinate sequence with a supplied common bound on finite sums of squares.
claims.conclusion: A PR strong ell2 name is equivalent, by explicit transformations, to a PR tail modulus tau satisfying sum_{tau(k)<=i<L}a_i^2<=4^(-k) for every finite L>=tau(k).
claims.object_ipra_status: Planned Prf PRAAx derivations; no new literal object proof value for this result is delivered.
key_exclusions: No tail modulus is inferred merely from the bound on finite squared sums.

claims.title: Bounded functional without a computable strong representative
hypotheses: The specified bounded-simulation encoding of first halting times into rational coordinates.
claims.conclusion: An exact PR bounded functional on finite rational vectors, with norm <=1, has no computable strong Riesz representative.
claims.object_ipra_status: External noncomputability argument; not claimed as a newly formalized object-iPRA theorem or a sentence-independence proof.
key_exclusions: External noncomputability theorem; not a newly formalized independence result for a particular iPRA sentence.

claims.title: Coercive bilinear values need not supply a strong operator
hypotheses: The preceding functional L and the exact rational form a(v,w)=<v,w>+L(v)L(w).
claims.conclusion: The form has coercivity >=1 and boundedness constant <=2, but has no computable strong representing operator.
claims.object_ipra_status: External noncomputability argument; not claimed as a newly formalized object-iPRA theorem or a sentence-independence proof.
key_exclusions: The positive operator/PDE theorems require stronger input representations.

claims.title: Finite differentiated geometric bound
hypotheses: Rational 0<=t<1 and natural j,L.
claims.conclusion: sum_{n=j}^L (n)_j t^(n-j)<=j!/(1-t)^(j+1), proved by finite tuple counting and geometric sums.
claims.object_ipra_status: Planned Prf PRAAx derivations; no new literal object proof value for this result is delivered.
key_exclusions: The proof does not differentiate an infinite series.

claims.title: Derivative-tail estimate and holomorphic interpretation
hypotheses: Positive rational R, nonnegative rational M, and a fixed joint PR Gaussian-rational evaluator for b_n=R^n a_n with proved |b_n|<=M.
Rational 0<=r<R, requested derivative order J, and finite L>=N>=J.
claims.conclusion: All derivative tails j<=J satisfy |P_L^(j)-P_N^(j)|<=K_j*sigma^(N+1) on |z|<=r, with the declared rational K_j and sigma. The coefficient presentation gives PR uniform derivative names and a holomorphic semantic function on |z|<R.
claims.object_ipra_status: Planned Prf PRAAx derivations; no new literal object proof value for this result is delivered.
key_exclusions: A certified radius and coefficient bound are inputs; bare analyticity is not used as an effective replacement.

claims.title: Simultaneous derivative entropy bound
hypotheses: The analytic-tail inputs and a requested precision k; the explicit A6 integer schedules and coefficient grid.
claims.conclusion: Finite rational observations select an ambient polynomial with C^J error <=2^(-k-1); the explicit cover cardinality is (2L0*2^p+1)^(2(N+1)).
claims.object_ipra_status: Planned Prf PRAAx derivations; no new literal object proof value for this result is delivered.
key_exclusions: Cover polynomials need not satisfy the original coefficient bound or belong to the input family.
No convergent-subsequence selector.
Differentiation on the same closed disk is not asserted continuous in uniform norm.

key_exclusions: No new main theorem is delivered as a literal Prf PRAAx derivation.
No general embedding of arbitrary continuous or analytic theories into iPRA.
No exact truth or arbitrary-real zero decision from finite observations.
No general logical compactness, model existence, ultrafilter or saturation construction.
No general computable subsequence extraction or automatic coherence of approximate witnesses.
No strong Riesz representative or strong operator synthesized from merely weak bounded values.
No uniform analytic radius/bound extraction from a merely continuous representation plus bare analyticity.
No claim that exterior approximation centers are selected from an arbitrary original family.

definition_consistency_review.regular_name_equality: The shifted equality test in foundations and eventual equality in category/model are equivalent on regular names; transitivity uses finer stages and rational separation.
definition_consistency_review.exact_dense_constants: The exact finite metric-formula variant uses dense codes for constants. Arbitrary named constants are handled through the later approximate-atomic evaluator variant.
definition_consistency_review.local_gluing_domains: The global function agrees with restrictions to r-balls; the input local domains are larger 2r-balls.
